description: Per-mutation errors the previous Smithy SDK typed (patches/addons/*.patch.json and patches/builders/ensureDepotRemoteBuilder.patch.json), with the same message matchers. The leading letter of 'not authorized' and 'could not find' is left out because Fly sends both cases; RemoteBuilderAppNotFound also requires the NOT_FOUND code, so it wins over the global FlyNotFound as the more specific match.
